first_pilot.reserve: Keep credits for replacement takes and isolation failures. No account accessed, credits spent, exact cost assumed or song generated.

reuse_contract.same_song_different_arrangements: One approved vocal PCM master per singer/song/phrase. Sparse, groove and fuller backing reference the identical vocal asset and start frame; retain exact melody/lyrics/timing and change only compatible instrumental stems/mix. Same phrase ID across arrangements, never claim EQ creates a new performance.
reuse_contract.different_songs_same_singer: Use a private generated-character Style Persona as guidance, then verify identity by listening. This does not guarantee identical timbre; reject drift. It is not the separately verified own-human-voice feature.
reuse_contract.separate_characters: Do not assign the same singer master to multiple canonical singers as if they are different people.
reuse_contract.harmony_and_time: Identical vocal reuse requires compatible actual tempo, meter, key, progression and phrase positions. Do not drop it over the existing109/114/136BPM banks.100BPM here is a new target, not a claim about supplied recordings.
reuse_contract.future_transforms: Do not silently pitch-shift/time-stretch. Any approved transform remains a derivative with original/master binding and new listening check.
reuse_contract.phrase_boundaries: Prefer complete2bar/4bar phrases; record actual pickup, source start/end frame, downbeat anchor and reverb tail. At verified100BPM4/4,2bars=4.8seconds and4bars=9.6seconds excluding pickup/tail.
reuse_contract.storage: Keep longer private original masters and selected excerpts; bundle only used short derivatives. Preserve original hashes, exact source take and all stem offsets.
reuse_contract.delivery: WAV stems and full reference mix from one chosen take/export range: lead vocal, keys, guitar, bass, drums; separate backing vocal if present. Same timeline origin/duration, no per-stem auto-trimming, normalization or independent silence removal. AI separation may bleed; listen to each stem and mixed result.
reuse_contract.runtime_boundary: Current recorded_steady.gd supports guitar/bass/drums with five tone/part assets. Vocals/keys are not currently supported. Add a separately versioned recipe/bank/participant binding only after accepted assets; preserve all old hooks/uses and saved arrangements. No present save schema change.

review_acceptance: Approve fictional voice identity per actual character; no voice gender/range invented from appearance.
Confirm true tempo/meter/key/progression, clean phrase boundaries and exact stem alignment.
Listen for bleed, unwanted music/doubling, word clipping and natural keyboard/vocal interplay.
Compare same vocal at identical timing across sparse/groove/full backings; verify vocal PCM SHA identical.
Use same character cohort/source binding in auditions, writing, rehearsal and saved gig excerpts; never add a missing singer/keyboard player to a trio.
Separate composition quality and musical complexity from actual character ability; do not turn low collaboration/reliability into deliberately poor singing.
